justification: Scratch registry v3 records whether a scratch owns a managed instance root or a historical source-root identity. Version 3 migrates v1 and v2 rows to layout legacy while preserving their recorded root, so destroy still withdraws the old route owner.

Doctor findings gain a CertificateTrustDetails member ({ trustStores }) so the certs check carries typed per-store trust rows. Existing members are unchanged; consumers that switch on the known shapes keep working and can ignore the new one.

RuntimeProvider.destroy is replaced by bringDown; its receipt is BringDownOutcome, whose removed arm carries the same volume counts, skipped volumes, and shutdown observations plus per-container receipts. No persisted state or command result embeds DestroyOutcome.

RuntimeProvider.removeObservedService is replaced by bringDownObserved; its receipt is ObservedBringDown, which reports the per-container action with the same optional shutdown observations. No persisted state or command result embeds ObservedServiceRemoval.
The command variant of RunProps accepts an optional capture. Existing command, shell, and library props are unchanged.
